title: AgentAlign: Navigating Safety Alignment in the Shift from Informative to Agentic Large Language Models
summary: AgentAlign synthesizes agentic safety-alignment data from abstract behavior chains instantiated with simulated tools; fine-tuning three model families improves AgentHarm safety by 35.8-79.5% with preserved helpfulness.

title: Personalized Constitutionally-Aligned Agentic Superego: Secure AI Behavior Aligned to Diverse Human Values
summary: Superego oversight agent validates plans against user-selected constitutions and a universal ethical floor before execution; up to 98.3% harm-score reduction on HarmBench and AgentHarm.

title: SecInfer: Preventing Prompt Injection via Inference-time Scaling
summary: SecInfer samples responses under diverse system prompts and aggregates by target-task fit at inference time; lowers prompt-injection ASR on InjecAgent and AgentDojo versus fine-tuning defenses.

title: Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Model Agent Safety
summary: ARLAS co-trains a prompt-injection attacker and a defending agent as a zero-sum game with population-based RL; lower ASR and higher task success on BrowserGym and AgentDojo.

title: CommandSans: Securing AI Agents with Surgical Precision Prompt Sanitization
summary: CommandSans strips AI-directed instructions from tool outputs token by token, trained only on instruction-tuning data; ASR 34% to 3% on AgentDojo, no utility loss on BIPIA, InjecAgent, ASB.

title: PISanitizer: Preventing Prompt Injection to Long-Context LLMs via Prompt Sanitization
summary: PISanitizer lets an LLM follow context instructions, then removes high-attention tokens driving instruction following; prevents injection on LongBench, InjecAgent and AgentDojo while keeping utility.

title: SIEVE: Selective Integrity Verification and Escalation for Defending LLM Agents against Indirect Prompt Injection
summary: SIEVE checks tool transitions and argument sources against an Intent Graph, escalating only ambiguous actions to semantic adjudication; 5.94% ASR with 97.5% clean utility on AgentLure, also AgentDojo.

title: QuadSentinel: Sequent Safety for Machine-Checkable Control in Multi-agent Systems
summary: QuadSentinel compiles natural-language safety policies into sequent-based machine-checkable rules enforced online by four guard agents, improving guardrail accuracy on ST-WebAgentBench and AgentHarm over ShieldAgent.

title: AgenTRIM: Tool Risk Mitigation for Agentic AI
summary: AgenTRIM reconstructs an agent's tool interface offline then enforces per-step least-privilege tool access with adaptive filtering and status-aware validation, cutting attack success on AgentDojo.

title: AgentSys: Secure and Dynamic LLM Agents Through Explicit Hierarchical Memory Management
summary: AgentSys borrows OS process isolation: a main agent spawns worker agents that run tool calls in isolated contexts, so injected instructions in tool output cannot persist in shared memory.

title: CausalArmor: Efficient Indirect Prompt Injection Guardrails via Causal Attribution
summary: CausalArmor computes leave-one-out attributions at privileged decision points and sanitizes only when an untrusted segment dominates user intent, avoiding always-on sanitization costs against indirect prompt injection.

title: DRAFT: Task Decoupled Latent Reasoning for Agent Safety
summary: DRAFT decouples agent-trajectory safety judgment into a latent Extractor and a Reasoner, raising accuracy from 63.3% to 91.2% averaged over ASSEBench and R-Judge.

title: When Agents Disagree With Themselves: Behavioral Consistency as an Uncertainty Signal for LLM Agents
summary: Run-to-run action-sequence divergence as black-box uncertainty signal; agreement of k=3 runs gives 87-88% accuracy at 54-62% coverage on HotpotQA, matching split-conformal.

title: AgentSentry: Mitigating Indirect Prompt Injection in LLM Agents via Temporal Causal Diagnostics and Context Purification
summary: Models multi-turn IPI as temporal causal takeover, localizes it via counterfactual re-execution at tool-return boundaries, then purifies context; eliminates successful attacks on AgentDojo across four suites and three attack families.

title: Cross-Layer Semantic Flow Reconstruction for Attack Detection in Agentic Systems
summary: AScope correlates agent-level semantics with kernel audit events into causal cross-layer flows checked by a supervisor LLM; node/path F1 of 85.3%/66.7% on cross-layer multi-agent data, evaluated also on AgentDojo traces.

title: PlanGuard: Defending Agents against Indirect Prompt Injection via Planning-based Consistency Verification
summary: Isolated planner derives reference actions from the user instruction; hierarchical verification blocks unauthorized tool calls and checks parameter intent; ASR 72.8% to 0% on InjecAgent, FPR 1.49%.

title: Safeguarding LLM Agents from Misalignment through Provenance Analysis
summary: ProvenanceGuard checks whether each proposed tool call is supported by traceable context evidence before execution; misaligned-trace error 44.3% to 2.1% on Agent-SafetyBench across 11 LLMs.

title: On-Policy Self-Evolution via Failure Trajectories for Agentic Safety Alignment
summary: FATE turns verifier-scored failed agent trajectories into on-policy repair supervision with Pareto-front policy optimization; reduces attack success rate by 33.5% on AgentDojo, AgentHarm and ATBench while preserving utility.

title: ProjGuard: Safety Monitoring for Computer-Use Agents via Low-Dimensional Projections
summary: ProjGuard derives a scalar risk signal from the computer-use agent's interaction history to detect drift toward unsafe regions and activates a VLM corrector on alert; unsafe rate 16% to 3% on OS-Harm with higher completion.

title: MemLineage: Lineage-Guided Enforcement for LLM Agent Memory
summary: MemLineage attaches Merkle-log cryptographic provenance and a weighted derivation DAG to agent memory entries and gates sensitive actions whose justification descends from external content; drives three memory-poisoning workloads to 0% ASR.

title: ADR: An Agentic Detection System for Enterprise Agentic AI Security
summary: ADR enterprise detection-and-response for MCP agents with telemetry sensor, red-teaming explorer and two-tier online detector; deployed at Uber on 7,200 hosts, 97.2% precision on credential exposure.

title: Aligning Provenance with Authorization: A Dual-Graph Defense for LLM Agents
summary: AuthGraph aligns an injected provenance reasoning graph from the execution trajectory with an authorization graph derived from clean user intent to detect tool- and parameter-source deviations; ASR 40% to 1% on AgentDojo at 76% utility.

title: TRACE: Trajectory Risk-Aware Compression for Long-Horizon Agent Safety
summary: Compressor-Reader design encodes full trajectory into latent evidence state for trajectory-level safety judgment; up to 12.6-point gains on ASSEBench, Pre-Ex-Bench and R-Judge.

title: From Risk Classification to Action Plan Remediation: A Guardrail Feedback Driven Framework for LLM Agents
summary: TRIAD guardrail outputs proceed/refuse/update with verbal feedback injected into the planner loop; average ASR 10.42% on ASB and AgentHarm with best safety-utility trade-off.

title: Stop Means Stop: Measuring and Repairing the Enforcement Gap in Agent-Framework Control Primitives
summary: SOUNDGATE is a mechanically verified (Verus, TLA+) external admission gate for agent side effects enforcing hold-until-decided and fence-on-cancel; blocks every measured leak on six frameworks at about 1 ms.

title: Twin Agent: Context Residual Compression for Privilege Separated Agents
summary: Twin Agent separates an Explore Agent reading untrusted context from a Safe Agent executing privileged actions, passing only compact hints; prevents prompt injection on AgentDojo and DecodingTrust-Agent with high utility.

title: CARE: Pre-Execution Command Verification for Shell-Executing LLM Agents
summary: CARE canonicalizes each agent shell command and applies static syntax, semantic and path-context evidence, escalating only underdetermined cases to an LLM judge; 85.64% F1 at 0.91% FPR and 2.32 ms.

title: Hardware Keystores for AI Agent Signing Workflows: A Zero-Trust MCP Enforcement Architecture
summary: Hardware-confined PKCS#11 keys plus a five-layer zero-trust MCP stack cut AgentDojo-style injection ASR from 19.3% to 0% with zero false positives on benign tasks.

title: SHE: Trajectory-driven Safety Harness Evolution for LLM Agents
summary: SHE decomposes the agent harness into system prompt, rule bank, safety memory and tool policy, evolving each from failure traces for a 3.1x ASR reduction on Agent-SafetyBench.

title: Bounded Agents: Delegation Security for Multi-Agent AI Systems
summary: The Agentic Principal Chain tracks delegated authority and composition closure across a session, cutting AgentDojo exfiltration from 75-100% to 0% and blocking all 544 InjecAgent cases.

title: From Sequence to Structure: Relational Uncertainty Propagation for LLM Agents
summary: RUPA propagates uncertainty over a directed trajectory graph of reasoning states, tool calls and feedback, outperforming local UQ methods on tau-2, Terminal-Bench-2 and GAIA across six LLMs.

title: AgentFlow: A Flow-Centric Policy Language and Framework for Securing LLM Agent Systems
summary: AgentFlow specifies flow and path policies over labeled runtime edges enforced by a reference monitor and bounded SMT verifier, cutting AgentDojo confirmed compromise from 33.0% to 0.0%.

title: StepGuard: Learning Step-Level Guardrails with Scalable Supervision and Safety-Utility Balancing
summary: StepGuard audits tool actions before execution, trained on StepGen counterfactual trajectories with Balance-GRPO, cutting mean ASR by 77.3% on AgentDojo and AgentDyn at 2.8 points utility cost.

title: SkillShield: Prompt-Space Security Skills for LLM Coding Agents
summary: SkillShield injects offline-synthesized security skills into the coding agent's system prompt, cutting RedCode malware severity from 3.37 to 0.58 at 0.14% benign refusal without a runtime classifier.

title: From Prompt Injections to SQL Injection Attacks: How Protected is Your LLM-Integrated Web Application?
summary: Characterizes prompt-to-SQL injections against Langchain SQL-chain apps and proposes four Langchain-extension defenses validated on a real-world application.

title: Testing Language Model Agents Safely in the Wild
summary: Context-sensitive AgentMonitor audits and stops unsafe agent actions during open-internet tests; evaluated against an adversarial simulated agent and on AutoGPT runs.

title: Efficient Non-Parametric Uncertainty Quantification for Black-Box Large Language Models and Decision Planning
summary: Single-inference non-parametric dependency estimator scores action trustworthiness for a black-box LLM decision agent, asking the user when several actions are uncertain.

title: Probabilistically Correct Language-based Multi-Robot Planning using Conformal Prediction
summary: S-ATLAS uses distributed conformal prediction so LLM-planned robot teams act when certain and ask for help otherwise, meeting user-specified mission success rates.

title: Security of AI Agents
summary: System-security analysis of tool-using agent vulnerabilities (sessions, sandboxing, model isolation) with a designed and experimentally evaluated defense for each.

title: TrustNavGPT: Modeling Uncertainty to Improve Trustworthiness of Audio-Guided LLM-Based Robot Navigation
summary: Audio-guided LLM navigation agent models vocal affective cues to estimate uncertainty about human command trustworthiness and make safer navigation decisions.

title: Athena: Safe Autonomous Agents with Verbal Contrastive Learning
summary: Athena guides tool-using agents with past safe/unsafe trajectories as in-context contrastive examples plus a critic; evaluated on a new 80-toolkit safety benchmark.

title: AgentMonitor: A Plug-and-Play Framework for Predictive and Secure Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Agent-level monitor captures MAS inputs/outputs to predict task performance and applies real-time corrections that mitigate malicious agents in multi-agent systems.

title: Safeguarding AI Agents: Developing and Analyzing Safety Architectures
summary: Proposes and evaluates three agent safety architectures: an LLM input-output filter, an integrated safety agent, and hierarchical delegation with embedded safety checks.

title: Enhancing LLM-based Autonomous Driving Agents to Mitigate Perception Attacks
summary: Hudson extends LLM driving agents to detect perception inconsistencies from memory and prompts, mitigating object-detection attacks that crash baseline agents 63% of the time.

title: MVVM: Deploy Your AI Agents-Securely, Efficiently, Everywhere
summary: WebAssembly secure-container framework with two-way sandboxing, live migration of agent workspaces, and integrated output validation for LLM agent deployment.

title: IBGP: Imperfect Byzantine Generals Problem for Zero-Shot Robustness in Communicative Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Relaxed Byzantine-consensus protocol lets communicative LLM multi-agent systems reach robust local agreement despite malicious or hallucinating agents of unknown identity.

title: SAUP: Situation Awareness Uncertainty Propagation on LLM Agent
summary: SAUP propagates per-step uncertainty through a multistep LLM agent's reasoning with situational weights, yielding trajectory-level uncertainty estimates a defense could act on.

title: POEX: Towards Policy Executable Jailbreak Attacks Against the LLM-based Robots
summary: Policy-executable jailbreak attack on LLM robot planners, with prompt-based and model-based defenses proposed and tested on real and simulated robot systems.

title: AgentGuard: Repurposing Agentic Orchestrator for Safety Evaluation of Tool Orchestration
summary: Orchestrator LLM autonomously discovers and validates unsafe tool-use workflows, then generates safety constraints that confine agent tool behaviors at deployment.

title: Guardians of the Agentic System: Preventing Many Shots Jailbreak with Agentic System
summary: Agentic anti-jailbreak system detects rogue agents via Reverse Turing Test and deceptive-alignment simulation in tool-mediated scenarios; 94% detection accuracy with Gemini 1.5 Pro.

title: AgentSafe: Safeguarding Large Language Model-based Multi-agent Systems via Hierarchical Data Management
summary: AgentSafe secures LLM multi-agent systems with ThreatSieve authority verification against impersonation and HierarCache security-level memory management restricting sensitive data to authorized agents.

title: SafePlan: Leveraging Formal Logic and Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Enhanced Safety in LLM-based Robotic Task Planning
summary: Formal-logic invariant/precondition/postcondition and prompt-sanity CoT reasoners vet LLM robot task prompts and plans, cutting harmful prompt acceptance by 90.5%.

title: In-Context Defense in Computer Agents: An Empirical Study
summary: Few curated in-context exemplars trigger defensive reasoning before action planning in VLM computer agents, cutting pop-up attack success by 91.2% and environment injection by 74.6%.

title: Safety Aware Task Planning via Large Language Models in Robotics
summary: SAFER runs a Safety Agent alongside the LLM task planner to give safety feedback on robotic plans, with an LLM-as-a-Judge safety metric.

title: MCP Safety Audit: LLMs with the Model Context Protocol Allow Major Security Exploits
summary: Demonstrates MCP tool exploits and releases MCPSafetyScanner, an agentic pre-deployment auditor that generates adversarial samples and remediation reports for arbitrary MCP servers.

title: MCP Guardian: A Security-First Layer for Safeguarding MCP-Based AI System
summary: Security layer for MCP tool traffic adding authentication, rate limiting, logging, tracing and WAF scanning; empirical tests show attack mitigation with minimal overhead.

title: A Framework for Benchmarking and Aligning Task-Planning Safety in LLM-Based Embodied Agents
summary: Safe-BeAl pairs SafePlan-Bench (2,027 tasks, 8 hazard categories) with Safe-Align, which injects physical-safety knowledge into embodied planners, improving safety by 8.55-15.22% over GPT-4 agents.

title: Advancing Embodied Agent Security: From Safety Benchmarks to Input Moderation
summary: Pinpoint prompt-decoupled input moderator with masked attention screens embodied-agent instructions, reaching 94.58% average detection accuracy on EAsafetyBench.

title: Securing GenAI Multi-Agent Systems Against Tool Squatting: A Zero Trust Registry-Based Approach
summary: Zero-trust Agent and Tool Registry with admin-controlled registration, fine-grained access policies, vulnerability-based trust scoring and just-in-time credentials to prevent tool squatting in MCP-style MAS (design only).

title: Maris: A Formally Verifiable Privacy Policy Enforcement Paradigm for Multi-Agent Collaboration Systems
summary: Reference monitors embedded in AutoGen/LangChain conversation components enforce message-flow policies, mitigating sensitive-data leakage across three task suites with high task success.

title: Think Twice Before You Act: Enhancing Agent Behavioral Safety with Thought Correction
summary: Plug-in Thought-Aligner causally corrects unsafe agent thoughts before action execution; raises behavioral safety from about 50% to about 90% on agent-safety benchmarks across six LLMs.

title: PeerGuard: Defending Multi-Agent Systems Against Backdoor Attacks Through Mutual Reasoning
summary: PeerGuard has each agent evaluate peers reasoning to flag illogical (backdoored) agents in LLM multi-agent systems; high detection accuracy with low false positives on ChatGPT and Llama 3 MAS.

title: Improving Google A2A Protocol: Protecting Sensitive Data and Mitigating Unintended Harms in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Adds consent orchestration, ephemeral scoped tokens and direct user-to-service channels to the A2A protocol; adversarial prompt-injection tests show substantially reduced sensitive-data leakage at low latency.

title: Tools in the Loop: Quantifying Uncertainty of LLM Question Answering Systems That Use Tools
summary: Jointly quantifies LLM and external-tool predictive uncertainty for tool-calling QA systems via sequence-level UQ extensions; evaluated on two tool-requiring synthetic QA datasets and a RAG proof of concept.

title: MedSentry: Understanding and Mitigating Safety Risks in Medical LLM Multi-Agent Systems
summary: MedSentry pairs a 5,000-prompt medical benchmark with a personality-scale detection-and-correction mechanism that identifies and rehabilitates malicious agents across four multi-agent topologies.

title: LLM Agents Should Employ Security Principles
summary: AgentSandbox embeds defense-in-depth, least privilege and complete mediation across the agent life-cycle; keeps benign utility while substantially reducing attack success and privacy leakage.

title: SafeScientist: Toward Risk-Aware Scientific Discoveries by LLM Agents
summary: SafeScientist adds prompt, agent-collaboration and tool-use monitors plus an ethical reviewer to an AI-scientist agent; improves safety by 35% on SciSafetyBench without reducing output quality.

title: MCP Safety Training: Learning to Refuse Falsely Benign MCP Exploits using Improved Preference Alignment
summary: DPO refusal training on a new dataset of falsely-benign MCP exploits, plus RAG-based preference alignment (RAG-Pref), substantially improves MCP agents refusal of retrieval-based attacks.

title: SAFEFLOW: A Principled Protocol for Trustworthy and Transactional Autonomous Agent Systems
summary: SAFEFLOW enforces information-flow-control labels on all data exchanged among agents, tools and users plus transactional execution; keeps task performance and security on SAFEFLOWBENCH under adversarial conditions.

title: Monitoring Decomposition Attacks in LLMs with Lightweight Sequential Monitors
summary: Lightweight sequential monitor cumulatively scores each decomposed subtask to catch long-range malicious intent across QA, text-to-image and agentic tasks; 93% defense success at 90% lower cost than o3-mini monitoring.

title: UProp: Investigating the Uncertainty Propagation of LLMs in Multi-Step Agentic Decision-Making
summary: UProp decomposes multi-step agent decision uncertainty into intrinsic and extrinsic (mutual-information) parts, estimating the latter via PMI over trajectory-dependent decision processes; outperforms single-turn UQ baselines on AgentBench and HotpotQA.

title: SafeMobile: Chain-level Jailbreak Detection and Automated Evaluation for Multimodal Mobile Agents
summary: Chain-level risk discrimination from behavioral-sequence information for multimodal mobile agents plus LLM-based automated assessment; preliminary validation on high-risk tasks improves risky-behavior recognition and lowers jailbreak probability.

title: LogicGuard: Improving Embodied LLM agents through Temporal Logic based Critics
summary: LogicGuard pairs an LLM actor with a trajectory-level LLM critic emitting Linear Temporal Logic constraints against unsafe actions; +25% task completion on Behavior household tasks, safer Minecraft runs.

title: Who's the Mole? Modeling and Detecting Intention-Hiding Malicious Agents in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: AgentXposed detects intention-hiding malicious agents in LLM multi-agent systems via HEXACO questionnaire probing plus Reid-style behavioral inter-agent monitoring; effective across six datasets and three communication structures.

title: WebGuard: Building a Generalizable Guardrail for Web Agents
summary: WebGuard: 4,939 human-annotated web-agent actions with a SAFE/LOW/HIGH risk schema; a fine-tuned Qwen2.5VL-7B guardrail raises action-outcome accuracy from 37% to 80% and HIGH-risk recall from 20% to 76%.

title: Byzantine-Robust Decentralized Coordination of LLM Agents
summary: DecentLLMs replaces leader-driven consensus with concurrent worker proposals scored by evaluator agents under Byzantine-robust aggregation; tolerates Byzantine LLM agents and selects higher-quality answers.

title: BlockA2A: Towards Secure and Verifiable Agent-to-Agent Interoperability
summary: BlockA2A combines decentralized identifiers, blockchain-anchored audit ledgers and smart-contract access control with a Defense Orchestration Engine; neutralizes prompt, communication and behavioral MAS attacks with sub-second overhead.

title: Evo-MARL: Co-Evolutionary Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Internalized Safety
summary: Evo-MARL trains every task agent in a multimodal-LLM multi-agent system to resist attacks via co-evolutionary attacker-defender MARL; cuts attack success up to 22% and raises accuracy up to 5%.

title: HarmonyGuard: Toward Safety and Utility in Web Agents via Adaptive Policy Enhancement and Dual-Objective Optimization
summary: HarmonyGuard adds a Policy Agent extracting and updating security policies from documents and a Utility Agent doing dual-objective reasoning for web agents; policy compliance up 38%, task completion up 20%.

title: Unintended Misalignment from Agentic Fine-Tuning: Risks and Mitigation
summary: PING prepends automatically searched natural-language prefixes to agent responses to restore refusal after agentic fine-tuning; outperforms prompting baselines on web-navigation and code-generation benchmarks without utility loss.

title: S3LoRA: Safe Spectral Sharpness-Guided Pruning in Adaptation of Agent Planner
summary: S3LoRA data-free prunes LoRA layers whose updates show high spectral sharpness to restore safety of adapted agent planners; improves safety metrics while keeping utility and cutting inference cost.

title: MindGuard: Intrinsic Decision Inspection for Securing LLM Agents Against Metadata Poisoning
summary: MindGuard builds an attention-derived Decision Dependence Graph of agent reasoning to detect and attribute MCP tool-poisoning at decision level; 94-99% average precision, 95-100% attribution accuracy, sub-second.

title: Enhancing Reliability in LLM-Integrated Robotic Systems: A Unified Approach to Security and Safety
summary: Unified framework of prompt assembling, state management and safety validation for LLM-integrated mobile robots; 30.8% improvement under prompt-injection attacks and up to 325% in adversarial complex environments over baselines.

title: Towards Agents That Know When They Don't Know: Uncertainty as a Control Signal for Structured Reasoning
summary: Uncertainty-aware multi-table biomedical agent uses retrieval-entropy and summary-uncertainty (self-consistency plus perplexity) signals for GRPO training and inference-time filtering; correct claims per summary roughly triple on multi-omics benchmarks.

title: Agentic JWT: A Secure Delegation Protocol for Autonomous AI Agents
summary: Agentic JWT binds each agent action to verifiable user intent via hashed agent identity, chained delegation assertions and proof-of-possession keys; PoC blocks scope violations, replay, impersonation and injection sub-millisecond.

title: Sentinel Agents for Secure and Trustworthy Agentic AI in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Distributed Sentinel Agents monitor inter-agent messages with LLM semantic analysis and anomaly detection; detected all 162 synthetic injection, hallucination and exfiltration attacks in a simulated MAS.

title: Secure and Efficient Access Control for Computer-Use Agents via Context Space
summary: CSAgent enforces static intent- and context-aware access-control policies via an OS service for computer-use agents; blocks all benchmark attacks with 1.99% overhead and 5.42% utility loss.

title: Preventing Prompt Injection with Type-Directed Privilege Separation
summary: Type-directed privilege separation converts untrusted tool data into scoped typed values so injected text cannot reach the planner; case studies show systematic prevention with non-trivial utility.

title: SafeMind: Benchmarking and Mitigating Safety Risks in Embodied LLM Agents
summary: SafeMindAgent adds three cascaded safety modules enforcing factual, causal and temporal constraints in a planner-executor embodied agent; higher safety rate on SafeMindBench (5,558 samples) with comparable completion.

title: AdvEvo-MARL: Shaping Internalized Safety through Adversarial Co-Evolution in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: AdvEvo-MARL co-evolves jailbreak attackers and defending task agents via multi-agent RL with a group-level baseline; keeps ASR below 20% (baselines up to 38.33%) while gaining up to +3.67% accuracy.

title: Quantitative Certification of Agentic Tool Selection
summary: LLMCert-T returns Clopper-Pearson upper bounds on the probability a tool-selection pipeline meets a safety specification under adversarial inserted tools; certified bounds fall to about 20% on BFCL/OpenAPI.

title: Uncertainty-Aware, Risk-Adaptive Access Control for Agentic Systems using an LLM-Judged TBAC Model
summary: LLM judge extends task-based access control with just-in-time policies, a task risk score and its own uncertainty estimate; high risk or uncertainty escalates to human approval; no evaluation reported.

title: From Refusal to Recovery: A Control-Theoretic Approach to Generative AI Guardrails
summary: Control-theoretic predictive guardrails in the model's latent world state monitor actions and correct risky ones via safety-critical RL; avoid collisions and bankruptcy in driving and e-commerce agents.

title: Formalizing the Safety, Security, and Functional Properties of Agentic AI Systems
summary: Formal host-agent and task-lifecycle models with 30 temporal-logic properties (liveness, safety, completeness, fairness) enable verification of MCP/A2A agentic systems; no empirical results reported.

title: SentinelNet: Safeguarding Multi-Agent Collaboration Through Credit-Based Dynamic Threat Detection
summary: SentinelNet gives each agent a contrastively trained credit-based detector that ranks neighbors and drops bottom-k messages; near-100% malicious-agent detection within two debate rounds, recovering 95% of accuracy.

title: SafeSearch: Do Not Trade Safety for Utility in LLM Search Agents
summary: SafeSearch trains search agents with multi-objective RL combining an output safety/utility reward with query-level shaping; harmfulness cut over 90% on three red-teaming sets for a 7B agent.

title: Securing Multi-Agent Systems Against Corruptions via Node Contribution Backpropagation
summary: Models MAS communication as a signed DAG and backpropagates each agent's contribution to the final decision to identify and isolate malicious agents; outperforms existing MAS defenses in dynamic environments.

title: AegisMCP: Online Graph Intrusion Detection for Tool-Augmented LLMs on Edge Devices
summary: AegisMCP models MCP activity as a streaming heterogeneous temporal graph with a CPU-only detector fusing novelty, session-DAG and attribute cues; sub-second alerting, beats sequence baselines.

title: AgentBound: Securing Execution Boundaries of AI Agents
summary: AgentBound applies Android-style declarative permission policies to MCP servers with an enforcement engine; policies auto-generated from source at 80.9% accuracy on 296 servers, blocking most threats with negligible overhead.

title: Beyond Prompt Engineering: Neuro-Symbolic-Causal Architecture for Robust Multi-Objective AI Agents
summary: Chimera pairs an LLM strategist with a TLA+-verified symbolic constraint engine and a causal module; zero constraint violations across 52-week e-commerce simulations where LLM-only agents lose $99K.

title: CoFineLLM: Conformal Finetuning of LLMs for Language-Instructed Robot Planning
summary: CoFineLLM finetunes LLM planners to be conformal-prediction-aware so prediction sets shrink at a fixed coverage; fewer user interventions than uncertainty-aware and agnostic finetuning on language-instructed robot planning tasks.

title: Securing AI Agents Against Prompt Injection Attacks
summary: Combines embedding-based content filtering, hierarchical system-prompt guardrails and multi-stage response verification for RAG-enabled agents; ASR 73.2% to 8.7% on 847 adversarial cases with 94.3% task performance retained.

title: BrowseSafe: Understanding and Preventing Prompt Injection Within AI Browser Agents
summary: BrowseSafe builds a benchmark of injections in realistic HTML payloads, evaluates existing defenses across frontier models, and proposes a layered architectural plus model-based defense for browser agents.

title: A Safety and Security Framework for Real-World Agentic Systems
summary: Agentic risk taxonomy plus a dynamic framework using auxiliary AI models with human oversight for contextual risk discovery, evaluation and mitigation, including sandboxed AI red teaming; NVIDIA case study.

title: AgentBay: A Hybrid Interaction Sandbox for Seamless Human-AI Intervention in Agentic Systems
summary: AgentBay isolates agents in Windows, Linux, Android, browser and code-interpreter sandboxes with a hybrid MCP/SDK session a human can take over; agent plus human raises task success over 48%.

title: Semantic Attacks on Tool-Augmented LLMs: Securing the Model Context Protocol Against Descriptor-Level Manipulation
summary: Descriptor integrity verification, auxiliary-LLM semantic vetting and runtime guardrails against MCP tool poisoning, shadowing and rug pulls; unsafe invocations fall from up to 36% to 15%.

title: AgentCrypt: Advancing Privacy and (Secure) Computation in AI Agent Collaboration
summary: AgentCrypt adds a deterministic three-tier protection layer (masking to homomorphic encryption) over agent collaboration so tagged data stays private even when the LLM errs.

title: MiniScope: A Least Privilege Framework for Authorizing Tool Calling Agents
summary: MiniScope reconstructs tool permission hierarchies to enforce least privilege for tool-calling agents, adding 1-6% latency while minimizing granted permissions versus an LLM confinement baseline.

title: Zero-Knowledge Audit for Internet of Agents: Privacy-Preserving Communication Verification with Model Context Protocol
summary: zk-MCP pairs zero-knowledge proofs with the Model Context Protocol so agent messages are audited for format and rule compliance without revealing contents, at negligible latency.

title: Verifiability-First Agents: Provable Observability and Lightweight Audit Agents for Controlling Autonomous LLM Systems
summary: Verifiability-First architecture adds cryptographic run-time attestation of agent actions plus lightweight audit agents checking intent against behavior, evaluated with the proposed OPERA detection benchmark.

title: AprielGuard
summary: AprielGuard is an 8B safeguard model trained on prompts, conversations and agentic workflows with reasoning traces, outperforming Llama-Guard and Granite Guardian on multi-step scenarios.

title: Graph-Symbolic Policy Enforcement and Control (G-SPEC): A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Safe Agentic AI in 5G Autonomous Networks
summary: G-SPEC constrains LLM network-agent planning with a knowledge graph and SHACL checks, reporting zero safety violations and 94.1% remediation success versus 82.4% baseline on a 450-node 5G core.

title: AegisAgent: An Autonomous Defense Agent Against Prompt Injection Attacks in LLM-HARs
summary: AegisAgent detects semantic inconsistencies and runs multi-step verification and repair plans against prompt injection in LLM-based human activity recognition, cutting attack success 30% at 78.6ms overhead.

title: RoboSafe: Safeguarding Embodied Agents via Executable Safety Logic
summary: RoboSafe guards embodied VLM agents with executable predicate safety logic over short- and long-term safety memory, combining backward reflective and forward predictive reasoning to trigger replanning.

title: A Blockchain-Monitored Agentic AI Architecture for Trusted Perception-Reasoning-Action Pipelines
summary: A permissioned Hyperledger Fabric layer verifies inputs, screens proposed actions and immutably logs executions of a LangChain multi-agent MCP system, blocking unauthorized actions with acceptable latency.

title: Enforcing Temporal Constraints for LLM Agents
summary: Agent-C expresses temporal safety policies in a DSL, translates them to first-order logic and uses SMT during constrained token generation to block or repair non-compliant tool calls.

title: Audited Skill-Graph Self-Improvement for Agentic LLMs via Verifiable Rewards, Experience Synthesis, and Continual Memory
summary: ASG-SI compiles agent self-improvement into an auditable skill graph, promoting skills only after verifier-backed replay and contract checks, with a stated threat model and security analysis.

title: Toward Trustworthy Agentic AI: A Multimodal Framework for Preventing Prompt Injection Attacks
summary: Cross-agent provenance-aware framework sanitizes text and image prompts and independently validates LLM outputs via a provenance ledger before messages propagate through LangChain-style agent graphs.

title: MCP-SandboxScan: WASM-based Secure Execution and Runtime Analysis for MCP Tools
summary: SandScope executes MCP tools under WASI sandboxing and traces source-to-sink witnesses from environment, file and tool inputs into LLM-visible fields, plus semantic capability profiling.

title: Memory Poisoning Attack and Defense on Memory Based LLM-Agents
summary: Empirical study of MINJA memory poisoning on EHR agents that proposes and evaluates defenses; realistic pre-existing legitimate memories sharply reduce attack effectiveness.

summary: Hierarchical intra-agent, inter-agent and system-level uncertainty metrics predict multi-agent debate collapse and drive a policy optimization penalizing self-contradiction, peer conflict and low-confidence outputs.

title: Anonymization-Enhanced Privacy Protection for Mobile GUI Agents: Available but Invisible
summary: A PII-aware recognizer replaces sensitive mobile GUI content with deterministic type-preserving placeholders, keeping data usable for task execution but invisible to the cloud-based GUI agent.

title: When Actions Go Off-Task: Detecting and Correcting Misaligned Actions in Computer-Use Agents
summary: DeAction is a guardrail that detects misaligned computer-use-agent actions before execution and iteratively corrects them via structured feedback, outperforming baselines offline and online on MisActBench.

title: Grounding Generative Planners in Verifiable Logic: A Hybrid Architecture for Trustworthy Embodied AI
summary: VIRF pairs an LLM planner with a deterministic Logic Tutor over a formal safety ontology giving causal feedback for plan repair, reaching 0% hazardous action rate.

summary: AARM specifies a runtime that intercepts agent actions before execution, evaluates them against policy and intent alignment with accumulated session context, and records tamper-evident receipts.

summary: Aura replaces GUI scraping with a structured agent-native mobile OS architecture where a privileged system agent orchestrates intent and sandboxes app agents against spoofing, injection and privilege escalation.

title: Authenticated Workflows: A Systems Approach to Protecting Agentic AI
summary: Authenticated workflows enforce cryptographic integrity and policy intent at prompt, tool, data and context boundaries using the MAPL policy language, rejecting operations lacking valid proof across nine frameworks.

title: AIR: Improving Agent Safety through Incident Response
summary: Incident-response DSL in the agent loop detects incidents, drives containment/recovery via tools, and synthesizes guardrail rules; >90% detection, remediation, eradication on three agent types.

title: Unsafer in Many Turns: Benchmarking and Defending Multi-Turn Safety Risks in Tool-Using Agents
summary: ToolShield: agent self-explores new tools with generated test cases and distills safety experiences; cuts ASR by 30% on average on MT-AgentRisk multi-turn tool benchmark.

title: MCPShield: A Security Cognition Layer for Adaptive Trust Calibration in Model Context Protocol Agents
summary: Plug-in security cognition layer probes MCP tools before invocation, constrains execution, and updates trust from traces; defends six novel MCP attack scenarios across six agent LLMs.

summary: Local-first multi-agent memory with per-agent provenance isolation and Bayesian trust scoring against memory poisoning; trust separation gap 0.90 and 72% trust degradation for sleeper attacks.

summary: Aspect-oriented policy enforcement: Datalog policies over execution-context predicates maintained under an assume/guarantee contract, consulted by a reference monitor at every agent action for deterministic decisions.

summary: MOSAIC post-training with plan-check-act/refuse loop and preference-based RL over trajectory pairs; cuts harmful behavior up to 50% and raises refusal >20% on injection attacks across three model families.

summary: Propagation-dynamics model over a directed dependency graph plus a genealogy-graph governance plugin at the message layer; prevents final infection in at least 89% of runs across six MAS frameworks.

summary: Zero-fork runtime layer enforcing at ten OpenClaw lifecycle hooks: heuristic-plus-LLM scanning, session-scoped risk accumulation, policy controls over tools/paths/secrets, and tamper-evident audit; preliminary benchmark results only.

summary: Training-free defense against group collusion in multi-agent systems via continuous graph-based monitoring, honeypot inducement, and structural pruning; up to 88% detection accuracy across five datasets and four topologies.

summary: Friedkin-Johnsen opinion-dynamics model of LLM multi-agent networks shows one stubborn persuasive agent can trigger a persuasion cascade; derives defenses (more benign agents, peer-resistance, reduced trust in suspects) verified across topologies.

summary: OWASP-grounded MAS safeguard with a 20-type risk taxonomy, MAS abstraction layer, attack-probe evaluation modules, and runtime monitor agents coordinated by an LLM Judge Factory issuing real-time alerts on execution traces.

summary: Open-source middleware components intervening at six agent-lifecycle points (prompt conditioning, output processing, pre-tool validation, post-tool checking, response assembly) to detect and repair failure modes; no quantitative results in abstract.

summary: Model-agnostic permission layer with a policy DSL gating tool invocation by constraints and risk; stricter packs raise violation prevention from 0.000 to 0.681 across 225 trace-replay runs.

summary: Policy-enforcing MCP proxy and OpenClaw plugin intercepting every proposed action against a declarative policy, requiring human approval for sensitive operations, and recording an audit/replay trail.

summary: Non-LLM Delegation Authority Service enforces seven delegation-chain properties (TLA+-checked) at runtime; 100% TPR at 0% FPR on DelegationBench, blocks 30/30 black-box attacks.

summary: Distributed Sentinel propagates Semantic Taint Tokens via sidecar proxies and runs counterfactual graph simulation for cross-domain policy checks; F1 0.95 at 106 ms on PhantomEcosystem.

summary: Lightweight screenshot-level detector using a visual gradient-stability indicator and contrast-polarity-recovered action text to flag injected webpages; F1 0.75, 8x faster than GPT-4o prompting.

summary: MCP semantic gateway with pre-inference semantic firewall, tool-level RBAC and cryptographic human-in-the-loop approval, audited by enabled-tool-graph fuzzing; 100% discovery of unauthorized transitions over 500k sequences.

summary: Alignment contracts specify scope, allowed/forbidden effects and budgets over observable effect traces with finite-trace semantics and decidable admissibility; Lean 4 artifact, no empirical evaluation.

summary: XGBoost detector over 42 runtime features (prompt, session dynamics, tool usage, execution context) scores adversarial interaction trajectories; 9x faster than LLM detectors on 12,000 synthetic interactions.

summary: Uses token-level confidence scores instead of embeddings to prune or down-weight messages from malicious agents in MAS communication; improved robustness across topologies against three embedding-evading attacks.

summary: sign-c server-side scheme authenticates execution-bearing response fields and a local shim verifies them before action, defeating BYOK relay tampering; rejects all tampered responses with zero false rejections.

summary: ARISE retrieves analogical ReAct safety trajectories as inference-time exemplars to improve safety judgment on ROME deceptive tool-agent trajectories without retraining.

summary: SkCC compiles agent skills to a typed IR whose static optimizer enforces security constraints pre-deployment; 94.8% proactive security trigger rate with sub-10ms compilation on SkillsBench.

summary: AgentTrust intercepts tool calls pre-execution with shell deobfuscation, multi-step RiskChain detection and LLM judge, returning allow/warn/block verdicts; 95.0% verdict accuracy on 300-scenario benchmark.

summary: Operation-centric risk confinement for self-hosted computer-use agents placing classification, authorization and evidence in an Intel TDX trusted plane; blocks unsafe operations on OpenClaw before execution.

summary: SkillScope graph-based analysis detects and constrains over-privileged actions in agent skills under task-conditioned least privilege; 94.53% F1 and 7,039 over-privileged skills found in the wild.

summary: ClawGuard passively audits agent skill invocations via electromagnetic side-channel signatures captured by SDR; AUC 0.9945, 100% TPR at 1.16% FPR detecting workflow hijacking.

summary: Agent-BOM hierarchical attributed graph of capabilities and runtime semantic states enables graph-query path-level risk auditing instantiated with OWASP Agentic Top 10, with an OpenClaw auditing plugin.

summary: PropGuard builds a dual-view spatio-temporal graph of LLM-MAS interactions, a GRPO-trained inspector recovers suspicious propagation subgraphs, then source-guided remediation replays affected interactions; lowers ASR across four architectures and five attacks.
