summary: Three composable methods (abstract-interpretation capability analysis, refinement types on tool-call envelopes, SMT-bounded model checking) raise agent skills to a mechanically checkable capability-containment proof.

title: AgentShield: Deception-based Compromise Detection for Tool-using LLM Agents
summary: AgentShield plants fake tools, fake credentials and allowlisted parameters in the tool interface as deception traps; catches 90.7-100% of successful IPI compromises with zero false alarms on 485 normal-use tests.

title: NEXUS: Continual Learning of Symbolic Constraints for Safe and Robust Embodied Planning
summary: NEXUS grounds probabilistic risk assessments into deterministic hard symbolic constraints as a pre-action defense for embodied planners with continual learning; refuses unsafe instructions on SafeAgentBench while raising task success.

title: Content-Aware Attack Detection in LLM Agent Tool-Call Traffic: An Empirical Study of Features, Architectures, and Evaluation Protocols
summary: Encodes each MCP agent session as a tool-call graph with sentence-embedding node features and classifies with GNNs; content features lift AUROC from 0.64 to above 0.89 on RAS-Eval and ATBench under task-disjoint splits.

title: Behavioral Integrity Verification for AI Agent Skills
summary: BIV compares declared versus actual skill capabilities via deterministic code analysis plus LLM-assisted extraction; 80% of 49,943 OpenClaw skills deviate and malicious-skill detection reaches F1 0.946.

title: OpenEvoShield: Dual Non-Stationary Continual Defense for Open-World Multi-Agent System Attacks
summary: OpenEvoShield co-evolutionary continual defense for LLM-MAS with asymmetric-rate drift control, EWC-regularized policy ensemble and energy-based node/subgraph/graph detector; detects most unseen attacks over 100 rounds on five benchmarks.

title: WARD: Adversarially Robust Defense of Web Agents Against Prompt Injections
summary: WARD guard model for web agents trained on 177K-sample WARD-Base and guard-targeted WARD-PIG with adaptive adversarial co-evolution (A3T); near-perfect OOD recall with low false positives and parallel low-latency deployment.

title: Formal Methods Meet LLMs: Auditing, Monitoring, and Intervention for Compliance of Advanced AI Systems
summary: LTL-based offline auditing plus sampling-based predictive and intervening runtime monitors for temporally extended behavioral constraints; significantly reduce violation rates of LLM-based agents while preserving task performance.

title: The Capability Paradox: How Smarter Auditors Make Multi-Agent Systems Less Secure
summary: Heterogeneous ensemble verification pairs Workers of asymmetric domain competence to break the certainty-to-execution chain behind semantic hijacking in MAS; ASR drops from 52.8% to 2.0% with negligible benign impact.

title: Prompts Don't Protect: Architectural Enforcement via MCP Proxy for LLM Tool Access Control
summary: Governed MCP proxy enforces attribute-based access control at tool discovery and invocation, removing unauthorized tools from context; unauthorized invocation rate drops from 48.5-68.5% to 0% across three models with 1.72ms overhead.

title: CASPIAN: Online Detection and Attribution of Cascade Attacks in LLM Multi-Agent Systems via Cross-Channel Causal Monitoring
summary: CASPIAN estimates a dynamic cross-channel causal influence matrix via late-interaction conditional transfer entropy to detect cascade onset and attribute origin/bridge/amplifier agents; outperforms guardrails and graph anomaly detectors at sub-1% overhead.

title: An Application-Layer Multi-Modal Covert-Channel Reference Monitor for LLM Agent Egress
summary: Application-layer egress reference monitor for LLM agents with ten capacity-reducing text stages, per-sink leaky-bucket capacity ledger, and attestation-gated media scramblers to close multimodal covert channels.

title: Causal Past Logic for Runtime Verification of Distributed LLM Agent Workflows
summary: Causal Past Logic adds past-time temporal guards over causally visible events to the ZipperGen agent-workflow language, with a vector-clock monitor proven to match denotational semantics for online runtime verification of distributed agent workflows.

title: MemAudit: Post-hoc Auditing of Poisoned Agent Memory via Causal Attribution and Structural Anomaly Detection
summary: MemAudit post-hoc audit combines counterfactual memory influence scores with a memory consistency graph to identify poisoned records; substantially reduces MINJA attack success in QA and reasoning-agent settings.

title: Agent-ToM: Learning to Monitor Autonomous LLM Agents via Theory-of-Mind Reasoning
summary: Agent-ToM monitors full agent trajectories by inferring beliefs and intent hypotheses with calibrated confidence via Reason-Verify-Refine, distilling critiques into a persistent semantic guardrail memory for covert-behavior detection.

title: Attested Tool-Server Admission: A Security Extension to the Model Context Protocol
summary: mcp-attested adds offline-signed clearance assertions verified against a pinned trust root, deny-by-default per-server tool allowlists, and tamper-evident audit logging to MCP tool-server admission in the Enclawed agent.

title: Sandlock: Confining AI Agent Code with Unprivileged Linux Primitives
summary: Sandlock unprivileged Linux process sandbox compiles static policy into kernel-enforced filesystem, network, IPC and syscall rules with a narrow supervisor for runtime decisions; about 5 ms startup overhead for agent-run code.

title: FinHarness: An Inline Lifecycle Safety Harness for Finance LLM Agents
summary: FinHarness inline harness with query monitor, per-call tool monitor, and cascade routing between light and advanced LLM judges, re-injecting fired risks as evidence; ASR 38.3% to 15.0% on FinVault with 4.7x fewer advanced-judge calls.

title: TRACES: Proactive Safety Auditing for Multi-Turn LLM Agents via Trajectory-State Modeling
summary: TRACES learns prefix-level trajectory risk states from observer-LLM hidden representations with weak trajectory-level supervision to flag drift toward unsafe behavior early across multiple agent safety benchmarks.

title: ChainCaps: Composition-Safe Tool-Using Agents via Monotonic Capability Attenuation
summary: ChainCaps attaches sink-specific capability budgets to values and propagates them by intersection through tool chains via a transparent MCP proxy; ASR 25-68% to 0-4.8% across five models with 96-100% benign completion.

title: LACUNA: Safe Agents as Recursive Program Holes
summary: LACUNA programming model makes each agent action a typed program hole filled with LLM code that is type-checked before execution, bounding tools and data flow and rejecting actions atomically; evaluated on BrowseComp-Plus and tau2-bench.

title: AgentGuard: An Attribute-Based Access Control Framework for Tool-Use LLM-Based Agent
summary: AgentGuard attribute-based access control for tool-use agents with client-server architecture, three inspection mechanisms covering single- and cross-tool risks, and a policy/audit front-end; no quantitative results in abstract.

title: AIRGuard: Guarding Agent Actions with Runtime Authority Control
summary: Runtime authority-control guard normalizes tool calls, derives step-level authority and simulates side effects; cuts Sonnet 4.6 ASR on AgentTrap from 36.3% to 5.5%.

title: Provably Secure Agent Guardrail
summary: Executable Proof-Constrained Action framework forces agents to formalize intentions into first-order logic before acting; reports zero ASR and zero false positives in simulated adversarial scenarios.

title: RAIL Guard: Closing the Evaluation-to-Remediation Gap in Responsible AI for LLM Agents
summary: Closed-loop evaluate-rewrite-reevaluate guardrail; pre-tool-call evaluation reduces unsafe agent executions by 33% on 6,400 tool-call scenarios with no task-completion loss.

title: Investigating Detection and Obfuscation of Prompt Injection Attacks Against Software Reverse Engineering AI Agents
summary: Detects prompt-injection strings in decompiler output consumed by reverse-engineering agents and studies obfuscation counter-defenses; no quantitative headline in abstract.

title: Send a SCOUT First: Pre-hoc Reasoning for Adaptive Detector Allocation in Prompt-Injection Defense
summary: SCOUT predicts per-request reliability of heterogeneous injection detectors and allocates them dynamically; cuts ASR 46% and wall-clock 40% vs always-on GPT-4o judge on agent-facing SCOUT-450.

title: Stateful Online Monitoring Catches Distributed Agent Attacks
summary: Stateful online monitor clusters weak suspiciousness signals across many agent transcripts to catch distributed cyber-misuse; flags attacks 30% earlier than per-transcript monitors.

title: COMPASS: Cognitive MCTS-Guided Process Alignment for Safe Search Agents
summary: MCTS-guided process alignment synthesizes stealthy attack trajectories and applies step-wise supervision to search agents; better safety-utility trade-off with less training data.

title: BraveGuard: From Open-World Threats to Safer Computer-Use Agents
summary: Self-evolving pipeline mines emerging threats, instantiates computer-use tasks and trains trajectory-level guard models; AgentHazard detection accuracy rises from 38.79% to 82.38%.

title: AgentRedBench: Dynamic Redteaming and Integration-Aware Defense for LLM Agents over SaaS Integrations
summary: AgentRedGuard, trained on tool-response injections across 24 SaaS integrations, cuts online attack success by 75-77pp across three model families at 0.0% real-benign false positives.

title: Defenses & Enablers For Skill Injection Attacks on Terminal Based Agents
summary: Dynamic and static guardian LLMs mediate or rewrite skill files for terminal agents; dynamic guardian lowers reframed skill-injection ASR from 81.4% to 18.6%.

title: SkillHarness: Harnessing Safe Skills for Computer-Use Agents
summary: SkillHarness learns a skill boundary from multi-source supervision and self-improving safety constraints so computer-use agents acquire and use skills safely under injections and pop-ups.

title: Caught in the Act(ivation): Toward Pre-Output and Multi-Turn Detection of Credential Exfiltration by LLM Agents
summary: Activation probes detect credential access pre-output, conformal-calibrated honeytokens and a cumulative leakage budget catch multi-turn exfiltration that per-turn detectors miss; preliminary.

title: SkillGuard: A Permission-Centric Framework for Agent Skill Security
summary: Skill-centric dual-plane permission model with manifests and runtime enforcement; reduces SkillInject ASR from 35.3% to 20.7% (contextual) and 36.7% to 18.0% (obvious).

title: RUBAS: Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning for Agent Safety
summary: Rubric-based RL rewards over tool-use, argument, response safety and helpfulness across full trajectories; improves safety over alignment baselines on multiple agent-safety benchmarks.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Clarification in LLM Agents with Information Gain
summary: Information-gain reward trains an agent clarifier to resolve intent uncertainty before tool actions; +3.7% success on clarification-enhanced tau-Bench with 0.3 extra steps.

title: Description-Code Inconsistency in Real-world MCP Servers: Measurement, Detection, and Security Implications
summary: DCIChecker cross-validates MCP tool descriptions against implementations via static analysis plus Direct-Reverse-Arbitration prompting to flag undeclared side effects; measurement study of real servers.

title: Provably Auditable and Safe LLM Agents from Human-Authored Ontologies
summary: Agentic Redux architecture with typed-lambda-calculus proofs of semantic correctness and an append-only decision ledger, demonstrated on healthcare billing and vulnerability disclosure domains.

title: VASO: Formally Verifiable Self-Evolving Skills for Physical AI Agents
summary: VASO represents LLM-generated robot skills as formal contracts model-checked against temporal safety properties before plans execute; verification-guided skill self-evolution.

title: Membrane: A Self-Evolving Contrastive Safety Memory for LLM Agent Defense
summary: Contrastive Safety Memory guardrail evolves harmful/benign cell pairs without retraining; best F1 on six jailbreaks on AgentHarm with benign refusal 7-14% vs 28-85% for prior guards.

title: Exploring Agentic Tool-Calling Decisions via Uncertainty-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
summary: TRUST adds uncertainty quantification to RL reward to keep correct and incorrect tool-call decisions separated; improves decision quality and calibration across tool-use benchmarks.

title: SciTrace: Trajectory-Aware Safety Reasoning for Scientific Discovery Agents
summary: SciTrace couples a cumulative safety-reasoning loop with a trajectory-aware tool-chain verifier for scientific agents; uncovers 78.8% of compositional tool-chain escapes on 360 risk tasks.

title: Oversight Has a Capacity: Calibrating Agent Guards to a Subjective, Fatiguing Human
summary: Frames the human-approval gate as selective classification with a fatiguing reviewer; load-aware escalation policy resists flooding attacks and shows safety is inverted-U in escalation rate on 125 labeled actions.

title: Game-Theoretic Multi-Agent Control for Robust Contextual Reasoning in LLMs
summary: GT-MCP controller selects among three agents via a trust function over a validated context graph and rolls back on drift; no injection succeeds and drift bounded in 99.6% of 500 adversarial turns.

title: Smarter Saboteurs, Better Fixers: Scaling & Security in Linear Multi-Agent Workflows
summary: Lightweight terminal Fixer stage in linear multi-agent coding workflows collapses the malicious-instruction performance drop from 53.7pp to 0.6pp at 27B on HumanEval.

title: SAIGuard: Communication-State Simulation for Proactive Defense of LLM Multi-Agent Systems
summary: SAIGuard simulates communication-state impact of incoming messages over the MAS interaction graph and sanitizes or regenerates risky messages before propagation; lowers ASR while keeping utility.

title: Goal-Autopilot: A Verifiable Anti-Fabrication Firewall for Unattended Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Autopilot gated finite-state machine with No-False-Success theorem forbids unverified done claims; fabrication on SWE-bench Lite falls from 33.7% (StateFlow) to 0.67%.

title: Runtime Skill Audit: Targeted Runtime Probing for Agent Skill Security
summary: Runtime Skill Audit dynamically probes skill-mediated agent behavior under targeted runtime conditions; 90.0% accuracy on 100 OpenClaw skills, +13.0pp over best static baseline.

title: SMSR: Certified Defence Against Runtime Memory Poisoning in Persistent LLM Agent Systems
summary: SMSR signs memories with HMAC at write time and uses randomized memory ablation with verdict-based voting at query time; certified bound, end-to-end poisoning success 65.3% to 5.3%.

title: Securing Multi-Agent GIS Systems: Risk Evaluation and Prompt Hardening Optimization
summary: Red-teaming with adaptive attacker LLM plus prompt-optimization that injects adversarial demonstrations into structured prompt signatures hardens a commercial multi-agent GIS system; no numbers in abstract.

title: PARSE: Provenance-Aware Retrieval Sanitization for Professional Domain LLM Agents
summary: PARSE classifies sentences by injection likelihood, extracts facts before rewriting and verifies preservation; ASR 25.4% to 15.6% at 86.9% utility on 122 real professional-domain documents.

title: ProvenanceGuard: Source-Aware Factuality Verification for MCP-Based LLM Agents
summary: ProvenanceGuard decomposes MCP-grounded answers into claims, routes them to source-specific evidence and returns per-claim and allow/block verdicts; evaluated on 281 medical MCP-agent traces.

title: The Gate Is Only as Honest as Its Contracts: ContractGuard for the Contract Layer of Risk-Aware Causal Gating
summary: ContractGuard verifies tool contracts with signed provenance, typed attestation and runtime effect verification before the RACG gate; restores injection success to zero including white-box adaptive attacker.

title: Uncertainty Decomposition for Clarification Seeking in LLM Agents
summary: Prompt-based decomposition separates action confidence from request uncertainty so agents ask clarification when underspecified; evaluated on WebShop-Clarification and ALFWorld-Clarification.

title: When Lower Privileges Suffice: Investigating Over-Privileged Tool Selection in LLM Agents
summary: Privilege-aware post-training teaches agents to prefer sufficient lower-privilege tools and escalate only when necessary; substantially reduces over-privileged tool use on ToolPrivBench.

title: AgenticOS: An Intent-Oriented Secure Operating System Architecture for Autonomous AI Agents
summary: AgenticOS turns the OS into an intent filter: agents submit structured intent declarations from which a least-privilege environment with mandatory mediation and information-flow constraints is synthesized.

title: AutoRAS: Learning Robust Agentic Systems with Primitive Representations
summary: AutoRAS learns to generate agentic-system designs as symbolic primitive sequences using execution-derived safety signals; smallest performance degradation under attacks.

title: Harness-MU: A Safe, Governed, and Effective Harness for Multi-User LLM Agents
summary: Harness-MU enforces multi-principal permissions and precedence via deterministic execution hooks rather than the LLM; privacy preserved under all access-control attacks on Muses-Bench.

title: When Does Belief-Based Agent Memory Help? Reliability-Conditional Updating and Provenance-Capped Poisoning Defense
summary: Provenance-capped Bayesian belief updating bounds memory trust by source provenance rather than textual confidence; resists volumetric memory-poisoning attacks in controlled experiments.

title: AgentLens: Interpretable Safety Steering via Mechanistic Subspaces for Multi-Turn Coding Agent
summary: AgentLens detects harmful execution states from step-level hidden representations and steers a 10-dimensional subspace at runtime; substantially fewer harmful actions on the 194-task MAS benchmark.

title: Governance Decay: How Context Compaction Silently Erases Safety Constraints in Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Constraint Pinning quarantines governance constraints from lossy context compaction; on ConstraintRot (1,323 episodes) tool-call violations drop from 30% post-compaction to 0%.

title: Detecting Malicious Agent Skills in the Wild using Attention
summary: Locate-and-Judge scores skill spans by instruction-following attention, then LLM-judges top-K spans; order-of-magnitude cheaper than full LLM scanning, flags dozens of live malicious marketplace skills missed by SkillSpector.

title: Securing LLM-Agent Long-Term Memory Against Poisoning: Non-Malleable, Origin-Bound Authority with Machine-Checked Guarantees
summary: TMA-NM binds non-malleable origin authority to memory items at write time (TLA+ machine-checked); 0% attack success on direct and laundering memory-poisoning attacks across eight frontier models at full utility.

title: ActPlane: Programmable OS-Level Policy Enforcement for Agent Harnesses
summary: ActPlane enforces agent-declared IFC policies in the OS kernel via eBPF with semantic feedback; improves policy compliance on indirect execution paths tool-call interception misses at 1.9-8.4% overhead.

title: AutoSpec: Safety Rule Evolution for LLM Agents via Inductive Logic Programming
summary: AutoSpec evolves expert safety rules via ILP-guided CEGIS from annotated traces; rule F1 reaches 0.98 (code) and 0.93 (embodied) on 291 traces with up to 94% false-positive reduction.

title: Uncertainty Quantification for Computer-Use Agents: A Benchmark across Vision-Language Models and GUI Grounding Datasets
summary: Argus benchmarks 27 post-hoc UQ methods and split-conformal click regions across 4 VLM GUI agents and 4 datasets; rankings transfer within model (Spearman 0.969) but not across model classes.

title: Adaptive Evaluation of Out-of-Band Defenses Against Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
summary: Systematizes out-of-band defenses (CaMeL, FIDES, Progent, RTBAS) and reproduces Progent on AgentDojo with Qwen2.5-7B; attack success falls 25.8% to 4.2%, adaptive attack 2.6%.

title: Autoformalization of Agent Instructions into Policy-as-Code
summary: LLM generator-critic loop autoformalizes agent prompts, MCP tool descriptions and policy documents into verified Cedar policies; covers more of the specification than hand-coded enforcement on MedAgentBench.

title: Self-Evolving Just-In-Time Memory for Proactive Embodied Safety
summary: Self-Evolving Just-In-Time Memory (belief graph, factual memory, mitigation meta-skills refined by a test-verify-write loop) raises Safe-Success rate on IS-Bench by up to 30.3% for embodied VLM agents.

title: Why Trust Your Agent? Empirical Security Gains from TRiSM-Guided Agentic Workflows in Healthcare
summary: TRiSM-guided least-privilege, defense-in-depth agentic workflow for medical report generation cuts RAG-poisoning attack success 31% to 10% and data-field injection 42% to 25% across five LLMs.

title: From Tool Connection to Execution Control: Benchmarking Security Invariants in MCP-Style Agent Runtimes
summary: HCP runtime enforces eight execution-layer invariants (grant-backed approval, scoped capabilities, data-flow authorization) for MCP-style agents; blocks 10/10 benchmark attacks versus 6/10 for a mitigation baseline.

title: Linguistic Firewall: Geometry as Defense in Multi-Agent Systems Routing
summary: ANTAP routes tasks in multi-agent systems by empirically tested capability operators instead of textual self-descriptions; near-zero attack success against description-based injection versus 67.3% for description routers.

title: Forensic Trajectory Signatures for Agent Memory Poisoning Detection
summary: Trajectory-feature detector for memory poisoning exploits the recall-before-send invariant (Random Forest AUC 0.99) but needs recipient-metadata gating to avoid 25-53% benign false positives.

title: MESA: Prioritizing Vulnerable Communication Channels for Securing Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Mesa ranks multi-agent communication edges by security criticality using graph metrics and ablation probes without attack traces; rankings correlate with per-edge attack success (Spearman 0.60).

title: Certified Speculative Execution for Untrusted AI Agents
summary: CGPA gates multi-step drafts from untrusted LLMs with an exact constraint verifier and a conformally calibrated value boundary; zero applied violations and 2.96x speedup at 2.1% regret on unit commitment.

title: AgentLTL: A Trace-Verification Framework for Measuring, Enforcing, and Training Procedural Compliance in Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: AgentLTL expresses FO-LTL procedural rules over tool-agent traces to gate tool calls online or score traces; block-and-warn harnessing improves compliance on five of seven models, reward finetuning +38 pp accuracy.

title: Cloak and Detonate: Scanner Evasion and Dynamic Detection of Agent Skill Malware
summary: SkillDetonate executes agent skills in a sandbox and detects malicious effects via OS-boundary taint tracking; 97% detection at 2% false positives, 87% on real-world malicious skills that evade static scanners.

title: UA-ChatDev: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Agent Collaboration for Reliable Software Development
summary: UA-ChatDev estimates agent-response confidence from token log-probabilities with phase-aware thresholds to trigger retrieval verification in multi-agent software development; improves SRDD completeness and executability.

title: ContextNest: Verifiable Context Governance for Autonomous AI Agent
summary: ContextNest adds a governance layer (hash-chained versions, deterministic selectors, audit traces) beneath agent retrieval; under a stale-version attack governed selection reaches 97% pass rate at one-third token cost.

title: DualView: Preventing Indirect Prompt Injection in Personal AI Agents
summary: DualView extends Dual-LLM symbol tracking of untrusted data to file system, shell and network via agent/human views (OpenClaw plugin); blocks every IPI attack including stored IPI on PinchBench.

title: Untrusted Content Masking for Web Agents with Security Guarantees
summary: Untrusted Content Masking redacts DOM regions of untrusted origin before the web agent sees the page and routes interaction through a privilege-separated sandbox, restoring provable isolation guarantees.

title: Your Agent's Memories Are Not Its Own: Forged Reasoning Attacks on LLM Agent Memory and Defenses
summary: SENTINEL Reasoning Guard scores memory entries with five weighted forgery signals; cuts FARMA forged-reasoning attack success from up to 100% to 0% with no false positives on 326 benign traces.

title: When Agents Go Rogue: Activation-Based Detection of Malicious Behaviors in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: AcMAS detects stealthy malicious agents in multi-agent systems from local activation-space states without interaction graphs and restores compromised agents; +0.22 F1 synchronous and +0.55 F1 asynchronous over graph baselines.

title: Mitigating Taint-Style Vulnerabilities in MCP Servers via Security-Aware Tool Descriptions
summary: SPELLSMITH builds tool-level risk profiles for MCP servers and embeds behavioral guidance in tool descriptions plus LLM self-reflection to mitigate taint-style vulnerability exploitation without code fixes.

title: ScopeJudge: Cost-Aware Pre-Execution Gating for Offensive Security Agents
summary: ScopeJudge evaluates cheap LLM judges gating each proposed tool call of offensive-security agents on 4,897 expert-labeled calls; static policy alone collapses recall, request-conditioned monitoring is necessary (expert F1 0.78).

title: Token-Flow Firewall: Semantic Runtime Auditing for Persistent AI Agents
summary: TokenWall audits source-sink semantic token flows (memory updates, tool arguments, retrieved files) before privileged sinks with local inspection and selective escalation; ASR 12.5% and 97.4% benign pass on CIK-Bench.

title: Persuasion Attacks Can Decrease Effectiveness of CoT Monitoring
summary: Pairs a CoT monitor with a fact-checker from a different model family against persuasive adversarial agents; approval of policy-violating actions drops up to 45% versus 6% for same-model pairing.

title: Evaluating and Guarding Citation Faithfulness in Agentic Scientific Synthesis
summary: Deployable citation guard for agentic literature synthesis uses a validated verifier plus split-conformal layer bounding unsupported citations that slip past flagging; validated on SciFact, QASA, PubMedQA across three agentic pipelines.

title: SingGuard-NSFA: Extensible Guardrails for Agentic AI via Generative Reasoning and Real-Time Classification
summary: nsfaguard guardrail models (0.8B-9B) combine SFT generative reasoning with classification heads for real-time detection of injection, tool misuse and exfiltration; at least 94% F1, 91.29% F1 cross-source.

title: Heterogeneous Agent Cohorts for Safe Open-Ended Exploration with Runtime Constraint Memory
summary: Role-separated cohort with a Validator enforcing runtime checks at the tool gateway and MCTS-compiled signed constraint patches (Scars); Validator prevents all executed breaches and Scars cut tokens 15.1%.

title: FlowGuard: From Signals to Evidence for MCP Security Detection
summary: FlowGuard vets MCP servers by semantic triage, schema-valid probe generation and runtime-evidence adjudication; F1 0.879 on command injection and 0.942 on file-system access across 1,880 executable cases.

title: Salience Induction against Multi-Hop RAG Agents: Threat and Defense
summary: Salience Normalization is an input-side defense against truth-preserving salience edits redirecting multi-hop agentic RAG (ReAct, Reflexion, tool-calling); attack success drops from 83.3% to 15.3% (23.6% adaptive).

title: ChannelGuard: Safe Models Do Not Compose into Safe Multi-Agent Systems
summary: ChannelGuard places training-free information-bottleneck gates on every inter-agent channel scoring text against an adversarial phrase bank; blocks tool poisoning 30/30 and halves prompt-injection success across three backends.

title: ChainWatch: A Kill Chain-Aligned Sequential Detection Framework for Multi-Step Attacks in MCP-Based AI Agent Systems
summary: ChainWatch classifies MCP tool-call sequences with a six-stage kill-chain HMM over 20 behavioral features to detect multi-step attacks composed of benign calls; demonstrated on five attack scenarios.

title: Operational Hallucination and Safety Drift in AI Agents
summary: Action-Aware Supervision Layer adds intent-action consistency checks, runtime state tracking and forced termination to counter safety drift and tool-call livelocks; intercepts captured violations with no benign false positives.

title: Protocol-Level Attacks on Agentic Commerce Platforms: A Cross-Platform Taxonomy, AIP-Bench, and Unified Defense
summary: PCAT is a platform-agnostic protocol-layer defense for agentic commerce; drives structural attack success to zero for four of five vulnerability classes on AIP-Bench without modifying platforms.

title: GuardianAgentBench: Where Agents Fail and How to Guard Them
summary: GuardianAgentBench (580 scenarios, LangChain/LlamaIndex/Vectara) plus an execution-time structural guardrail that recovers 19.9% of tool-use failures at 0.5% false-positive rate, beating system-prompt defenses.

title: ToolGuardian: Declarative Security for AI Agent-Tool Interactions
summary: ToolGuardian vets tools pre-admission via description, syscall trace, mock execution and source facts, then authorizes at runtime with Answer Set Programming policies; deny-class F1 0.86 on 16 MCP-style tools.

title: Mission-Level Runtime Assurance for LLM-Assisted ISR Swarms over a Verification-Aware Fabric
summary: Three-tier compositional runtime verification aggregates per-platform verdicts over a verification-aware fabric with evidence-aware algebra; detects injection-induced prohibited tasks split across four LLM-planned ISR platforms.

title: FinAbstain: Uncertainty-Calibrated Multimodal RAG for Selective Financial Forecasting
summary: FinAbstain aggregates multi-agent probabilistic assessments with contradiction, consistency and conformal calibration and abstains or routes to human review when uncertainty exceeds a validated threshold.

title: Early Detection of Distributed Backdoors in Multi-Agent LLM Systems: A Characterization Study
summary: Prefix detector on multi-agent runs flags 99.3% of distributed-backdoor attacks with five steps remaining at 10.3% FPR, but relies partly on removable ciphertext length/entropy cues.

title: SafeFlow: Semantic Information-Flow Control for Blocking Malicious Propagation in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: SafeFlow attaches semantic taints to requests, propagates them through the multi-agent collaboration graph and validates workflows before irreversible actions, lowering attack success on four benchmarks.

title: Hybrid Analysis for Secure MCP Tool Use in LLM Agents
summary: MTGuard defends MCP tool use with lifecycle-aware static-dynamic co-analysis, mitigating several categories of harmful tool use while preserving benign task performance.

title: SkillGate: Cost Efficient Runtime Malicious Skill File Detection in Coding Agents
summary: SkillGate screens agent skill packages before installation with a regex prefilter plus LLM judge, reaching F1 0.817 at 1.13% FPR on SkillsBench.

title: Runtime Uncertainty Monitoring for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems Using Bayesian Networks
summary: Bayesian-network propagation of length-normalised token log-probabilities yields calibrated task-level confidence for a multi-agent actuarial workflow at baseline task performance.

title: FAVA: Formal Authorization for Verified Agents with Evidence-Backed Permission Graphs
summary: FAVA lowers an LLM-generated permission IR into an evidence-backed permission graph and SMT-verifies each effectful action, reaching 90.5% decision compliance on OpenAgentSafety and OctoBench.

title: Think Short, Defer Smart, Act, and Repeat: Calibrated Reasoning and Uncertainty-Aware Deferral for Edge LLM Agents
summary: TSDS pairs a reasoning-convergence probe with perplexity-based cloud deferral, jointly calibrated by Learn-Then-Test, cutting thinking compute 43-65% under certified reward and call-rate guarantees.

title: MIND: Lightweight and Effective Memory Injection Defense for LLM Agents via Intent-Aware Information Bottleneck
summary: MIND uses an intent-aware information bottleneck plus a lightweight detector to flag poisoned memories, cutting ASR-r and ASR-a by about 55% on ReAct-StrategyQA.

title: Safety-Gated Agentic Supervisory Control on a Coupled Distillation Benchmark: Regime Map, Auditable Gate, and Co-Design Findings
summary: A rule-based counterfactual gate with nine pinned constraints admits or blocks LLM supervisory setpoints on a distillation column, bounding a specification-abandonment failure (P95 cell IAE 11.5 to 0.77).

title: Tool Specifications Matter: Uncovering and Mitigating Safety Risks in AI Agents
summary: SafeKeep judges requests using flattened textual tool specifications while executing schema ones, raising harmful-request refusal 23.8% to 70.6% and cutting injection ASR 25.6% to 2.5%.

title: Memory Provenance Laundering in LLM Agents: A Non-Amplification Firewall for Persistent Memory
summary: PPMF preserves platform-maintained memory provenance and authorizes tool calls by matching action risk to memory authority, blocking all evaluated unauthorized high-risk actions after consolidation laundering.

title: MAPLE-Guard: Memory-Aware Link Enforcement Against Memory-Link Poisoning in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: MAPLE-Guard gates memory write, retrieval, promotion and cross-agent reuse, cutting ASR from 38.2% to 0.9% on LongMemEval and 34.7% to 0.2% on AppWorld.

title: Safety Invariants for Agents Orchestrating Irreversible State Transitions: A Four-Dimensional Formalism Evaluated on Public Ledgers
summary: Seven safety invariants over a four-dimensional ledger state space prove execution fidelity for irreversible agent actions, raising pass rate ~74 points over naive ReAct on 60 adversarial cases.

title: Neuro-Symbolic Participation Governance for Verifiable AI Agents in Open Digital Twin Ecosystems
summary: Neuro-symbolic governance grounds agent capabilities in ontologies and validates organization-issued credentials via smart contracts, preventing unauthorized interaction across institutional digital-twin agents with manageable overhead.

title: Why Formal Monitors Fail: Attack Distribution Entropy as a Coverage Bound for LTL-Based LLM Agent Safety
summary: Proves LTL/FSA runtime-monitor recall is bounded by attack-distribution entropy across eight LLM backends (r=-0.87), and gives a pre-deployment entropy test for monitor selection.

title: $S^3$: Improving Agent Safety through Multi-Stage Defense
summary: S^3 composes stage-specific safety skills orchestrated by a guard agent across memory, planning and tool stages, outperforming baselines on the new Multi-Stage Risk Benchmark.

title: SkillSentry: Adaptive Honey Worlds for Dynamic Safety Testing of Agent Skills
summary: SkillSentry tests agent skills dynamically in LLM-simulated honey worlds with decoy resources and matched no-skill baselines, reaching 96.26% F1 and 92.95% under semantics-preserving evasion.

title: Post-Hoc Trajectory-Risk Certification for Modular LLM-Based Security Agents
summary: Spanning-tree conformal composition certifies trajectory-level risk for staged security agents, giving 92.7% average trajectory coverage at alpha=0.10 and a 13.7% tighter direct audit than Bonferroni.

title: DreamGuard: Efficient Runtime Guardrail for LLM Agents via Risk-Aware World Model
summary: DreamGuard runs a risk-aware world model over a latent trajectory state, fusing immediate-hazard and prefix-risk signals into pre-execution interventions at 25 ms average latency.

title: CyberLLM: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Autonomous Detection and Guarded Response in Automotive Cybersecurity
summary: CyberLLM validates every remediation action against four contextual security properties and an action-alignment oracle before execution, covering about 70% of seeded automotive vulnerabilities with zero false positives.

title: NiyamAI - An Intent-Bound AI Agent with Cryptographically Verifiable Guardrails using Zero-Knowledge Proofs
summary: NiyamAI seals permitted tools into a committed Intent Contract and emits a zkSNARK proof of policy evaluation per tool call, reaching 88.8% F1 at 1.0% FPR on AgentSafetyBench.

title: SkillConsist: Detecting Inconsistencies in Agent Skills via Bidirectional Graph Alignment
summary: SkillConsist builds declaration and implementation behavior graphs of agent skills and aligns them bidirectionally, reaching 87.93% F1 on a 633-skill benchmark, +20.4 points over baselines.

title: SkillsMetric: Mapping the Detection Boundary of Static Analysis for Malicious Agent Skills
summary: SkillsMetric scores skill packages across five static-analysis dimensions, reaching AUC 0.93 but detecting only 42% of prompt injection and 0% of host-destruction attacks.

title: Actionable Hallucination Detection: Translating Latent Uncertainty into Agentic Critique
summary: A LoRA Latent Critic restructures the frozen model's residual stream into localized natural-language grounding critique, reaching 0.966 AUROC and intercepting hallucinated tool calls in a ReAct loop.

title: Semantic Uncertainty-Guided Orchestration in Hierarchical Multi-Agent Systems
summary: HASSUM uses semantic entropy and semantic density to trigger verification, reprompting and confidence-aware selection in hierarchical multi-agent systems, improving reliability on StrategyQA, JailbreakBench and TruthfulQA.

title: ToolHazard: Scaling Adversarial Environments for Security Evaluation and Alignment of LLM-based Agents
summary: ToolHazard synthesizes adversarial tool environments whose generated alignment data improves agent security on ToolHazard-Bench and AgentDojo while preserving benign utility.

title: Beyond Single-Turn Confidence: Trajectory-Adapted Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Agents
summary: Evaluates white-box, black-box consistency and reflexive uncertainty scorers at agent-trajectory level across five LLMs on BFCL-v4 and tau^2-bench; self-consistency scorers rank strongest.

title: Beyond Handcrafted Security: Towards Self-Evolving Defense for LLM Agents
summary: HARD formalizes runtime defense at the harness level and self-evolves intervention strategies from observed failure traces, improving security over handcrafted defenses while preserving benign utility.

title: Practice Makes Unsafe: Skill Misevolution in Self-Improving LLM Agents
summary: SafeEvolve repairs unsafe evolved skills and governs their reuse, cutting unsafe retrieval and fresh-session harm by 26.7 and 17.3 points at 0.4 points benign utility cost.

title: InterSAGE: The Secure and Verifiable Interoperability Protocol for An Internet of Agents
summary: InterSAGE layers persistent agent identity, capability-aware credential discovery, attenuating trust negotiation and kernel-mediated cryptographic audit trails onto MCP and A2A interoperability.

title: Mandato: Protocol-Level Enforcement of Digitally Signed Mandates on AI Agent Actions with Cryptographically Chained Audit Trails
summary: Mandato proxies MCP tool calls against digitally signed mandates specifying permitted tools, parameter constraints and duration, logging every decision in a hash-chained audit trail.

title: BioFirewall: A genome-writing-native governance layer for design-stage biosecurity screening of agentic AI
summary: BioFirewall intercepts agent genome-writing plans with deterministic rules across five hazard axes, holding verdicts invariant under prompt injection where LLM judges flipped in 3-5 of 6 trials.

title: Proof-of-Execution Memory: Defending LLM Agents Against Forged-Reasoning Attacks by Verifying What Actually Happened
summary: PoEM records executed safety steps in an HMAC-chained ledger writable only by the trusted action layer, driving forged-reasoning memory attack success to 0% with no false positives.

title: A Policy Algebra for Trust-Preserving Agentic AI Execution
summary: A policy algebra composes security profiles and runtime obligations over identity, tool, memory, budget and approval constraints, intervening on 94.8% of policy-violating events at 86.9% task completion.

title: PACE: Policy-Attested Contract Execution for Safe AI Agents in Decentralized Finance
summary: PACE binds a deterministic policy verifier's signed decision record to the exact DeFi transaction bytes, achieving 0.00 unsafe execution and 0.00 false-positive rate over 2,800 trials.

title: Task-Conditioned Least-Privilege Learning for Executable Terminal and MCP Agents
summary: Least-privilege post-training with deterministic per-action auditors raises safe success from 64.36% to 98.48% and cuts excess-authority events from 4.56% to 0.79% on held-out terminal and MCP tasks.

title: PolicyGuide: From Guarding One Action to Guiding the Whole Workflow for Policy-Compliant LLM Agents
summary: PolicyGuide compiles each domain policy into a workflow graph and runs a proactive verifier at turn boundaries, raising mean Pass^4 on tau^2-bench from 0.42 to 0.62.

title: AEGIS: Preventing Cross-Domain Resource Abuse in MCP
summary: AEGIS normalizes heterogeneous MCP tool invocations into a policy-friendly representation and enforces administrator resource limits through Open Policy Agent and the ContextForge gateway.

title: Consilience: Conformally Calibrated Communication Control for Hidden-Profile Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Consilience selects multi-agent communication interventions under round-wise conformal calibration bounding one-step regret, improving decision accuracy and efficiency on hidden-profile tasks across twelve models.

title: SecOPD: Mitigating Adaptive Prompt Injections by On-Policy Distillation
summary: SecOPD scores rollout tokens against the initialization model on clean input for token-level defensive distillation, cutting adaptive PISmith ASR from 94.0% to 9.0% and agentic tool-calling ASR to 4.7%.

title: ClawSentry: A Progressive Multi-Tier Security Monitor for Safeguarding Autonomous LLM Agents
summary: ClawSentry gates skill admission plus three progressive runtime tiers with session anti-bypass, cutting contextual ASR on SkillInject from 39.55% to 2.61% at nearly unchanged task success.

title: $Z^2$-ACT: End-to-End Verifiable Agentic Intent Control for Open 6G RAN
summary: Z^2-ACT admits LLM-generated 6G intents only after adversarial intent checks and typed Intent Contracts, releasing skill sequences behind a self-management gate with zero-knowledge commit proofs.

title: AID-Guard: Stateful Authorization for Delegated Agent Effects
summary: AID-Guard revalidates approved requests against provider state at commit and holds one reservation under ambiguity, blocking 44/44 attacks under full proposer compromise without duplicate effects.

title: PropUQ-MAS: Propagation-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Multi-Agent Systems
summary: PropUQ-MAS represents multi-agent execution as a communication graph and combines local with inherited upstream uncertainty, gaining +6.10% AUROC and +47.58% PRR on average.

title: WebMCP-Phalanx: Enforcing and Characterizing Trust Boundaries for Browser-Integrated LLM Agents
summary: WebMCP-Phalanx binds browser tools to registering principals with capability credentials and routes page content through a tool-less quarantine LLM, blocking all 80 description injections and reducing overwrite attacks to 0%.

title: Auto-Policy, not Auto-Skill: Compiled Agent Skills for the Physical World
summary: Edge Skillguard co-packages a typed authority layer with skill procedures, rejecting 60/60 borrowed-authority actuation requests across five attack variants without blocking benign requests.

title: Reassembling Distributed Risk: Trajectory-Conditioned Action Generation for Multi-Turn Agent Safety
summary: ReDiR compresses the trajectory into a latent safety representation injected into the frozen model at generation time, holding multi-turn decomposition attack success below 8% across eight held-out tool domains.

title: The Framing Gap: Indirect Prompt-Injection Exfiltration Defeats Surface-Level Defenses in Tool-Using Agents
summary: Shows reframed exfiltration injections reach 100% ASR on tool-using agents while destination allow-lists and a planner/reader capability split close the gap to 0%, unlike SecAlign or channel separation.

title: Safety Does Not Compose: Non-Decaying Loop State for Autonomous LLM Agents
summary: LoopHarness keeps non-decaying cross-iteration safety state, bounding expected unauthorized irreversible actions by a constant in the horizon where trajectory-scoped monitors provably cannot separate attacks.
